note: Big-rig-friendly transient park just off I-29 exit 112 at Onawa, shaded, with long pull-throughs; walking distance to Dairy Queen, McDonald's and Subway. Dog park, propane. Inland lot, no water adjacency on satellite. --Claude
summary: Own site confirms full hookups, $45 / $47.50 / $49.50, 10% Good Sam and military, Campspot. Provenance to manual; wifi, store and booking fields added. Note cleaned. Not waterfront holds; private gate passes under $50.
flags: PRIVATE GATE: rate $45 cheapest night posted on its own site (2026 read). Under $50 before any discount; $40.50 with the stated 10% Good Sam/military. Top $49.50 still under. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Kansas City 351 km), not needed. I didn't open Campspot, so taxes and any person surcharge are unread; if an extra-person fee exists the two-person night at 30A has $5 of headroom. Presence: own website, phone 712-423-1387 (stored; not re-matched from the text I read). Google 4.8 on 487, RV Life 4.5 on 406, $$ avg $38.

LONG-STAY: passes. It says 'whether you're stopping for the night or settling in for the season' and sells $825/month on all sites, but the character is overnight: nightly rate + online booking; no minimum over 2 stated; recent reviews are nearly all one-night I-29 stops (RV Life 2026-10-05 'Great overnight pull thru', 2026-10-02 'great overnight stay', 2026-09-23 'quick, no frills, one night stop'). RV park, no home community on imagery: sites around a grass court behind a gas station.

REVIEWS worth seeing, Google, about 3 months ago: 2/5 'The new owners seem to have trouble following through on commitments... neither reservation seemed to be documented'; 2 months ago 3/5 'I booked online received my confirmation for the space i picked. When I arrived two vehicles were in the space.' Also 'Could use some gravel in the mud holes' (RV Life 2026-10-05). Ownership appears to have changed recently. Overall still 4.8, no gate issue.

Site spells itself both On-Ur-Wa and On-Ur-Way; website is now onurwarvpark.com (stored www. form redirects). The site's directions link puts it at 42.02568,-96.12647, ~150 m west of the stored pin; pin sits on the east edge of the sites under the tree block, centre about 42.0260,-96.1255, both within 250 m. No move.
